name: Salmon hotpot
summary: Lẩu cá hồi is one of the salmon plates the falls page names at the restaurant near the gate. A broth and a price were not printed there.
origin: Named at nhà hàng thác Bạc Sa Pa, and again on the national Sa Pa food list with the other salmon plates.
howToEat: At that restaurant, as a hotpot. The broth is check on arrival.
where: Nhà hàng thác Bạc Sa Pa, near the gate of Silver Waterfall, about 12 km from town toward O Quy Ho. Hours are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Salmon hotpot in Sapa — the falls restaurant
seoDescription: Lẩu cá hồi at nhà hàng thác Bạc, near the Silver Waterfall gate. Hours and the price are check on arrival.
